corpus_summary.llubi_ub_interpreter_status: PASS (exit code 0 across all 10 pass-group IR modules)

G8_LoopVectorize_SLP.primary_blocker: 256-bit/128-bit SIMD vector loop + scalar epilogue bit-blasting in SMT

Whole_O3_Pipeline.primary_blocker: compounded LoopVectorize + unroll + GVN over unbounded slices

failure_cause_taxonomy.description: LoopVectorize and SLPVectorizer transform scalar loops into 128-bit/256-bit vector operations plus runtime alias-check guards and scalar remainder epilogues, causing exponential QF_ABV bit-blasting timeouts (>10s) in Z3.
failure_cause_taxonomy.mitigation: Validate scalar loop passes before vectorization, or emit loop-vectorization Relational/VPlan certificates (O7/L2).

failure_cause_taxonomy.description: Bounded unrolling (`-src-unroll=k -tgt-unroll=k`) only checks finite prefixes of unbounded slice/iterator loops unless a relational loop invariant is supplied.
failure_cause_taxonomy.mitigation: Emit loop headers and induction invariants from the compiler pass (Crellvm / graph-refine cut-point synchronization).

failure_cause_taxonomy.description: Inline `asm!` and `naked_asm!` blocks are uninterpreted strings at the LLVM IR level (`call void asm sideeffect`).
failure_cause_taxonomy.mitigation: Defer `asm!` validation to the ISA machine-code lifter (Alive2 `--tgt-is-asm` / HolBA / Sail ISA semantics).

failure_cause_taxonomy.description: Rust `expose_provenance` / `with_exposed_provenance` lowers to `ptrtoint` / `inttoptr`, forcing the SMT encoding to model provenance wildcard exposure across all escaped allocations.
failure_cause_taxonomy.mitigation: Preserve explicit provenance sidecars or restrict `int2ptr` wildcard propagation to exposed allocations.

failure_cause_taxonomy.description: Heap allocation (`__rust_alloc`), unwinding landingpads (`landingpad` / `resume`), and large coroutine state machines exceed per-function memory-block encoding bounds.
failure_cause_taxonomy.mitigation: Validate MIR-to-MIR state-machine transforms before LLVM lowering and verify intra-procedural basic blocks modularly.
